notes:
v1.0.0 (2026-08-11) — D026 §18, real live-test finding: a claim about Nauru's population let a Vatican City page through gate #4 (isPassageRelevant, lexical presence only) because that page mentioned Nauru once in a comparison list while actually being about Vatican City. Semantic reranking, scoring 'is this candidate actually about the claim's subject' rather than 'does it contain a matching word', catches what lexical presence can't. UNVALIDATED against a real model as of this commit.

v1.1.0 (2026-08-21, g17 review round 2) — adds SUBJECT ENTITY, EXTRACT's own subject_entity field, as an explicit signal. Replaces a code-side hard pre-filter (hasSubjectEntity, applied ahead of this call) that a review found foreclosed this prompt's own coreference/pronoun handling and duplicated gates.ts's sameEntity() — same lexical-substring weakness this prompt was originally built to fix (D026 §18), just relocated to a new field. The entity check now runs inside this existing call instead, alongside the semantic judgment it already makes. UNVALIDATED against a real model.
